tests.name: fix: image has meaningful alt
tests.hint: alt answers: 'what would someone miss if they could not see this?' — describe the content, not the file type.

tests.name: fix: link text describes destination
tests.hint: Screen readers jump link-to-link out of context: each link's text must make sense alone.

tests.name: fix: heading levels step down
tests.hint: Headings are an outline: 1, then 2, then 3 — never jump from 1 to 4.

tests.name: predict & prove: ingredients in a ul
tests.hint: Shuffling ingredients changes nothing, so <ul> is the meaningful choice; steps would be <ol>.

tests.name: build: opening-hours section
tests.hint: Build from requirements: <section> → <h2> → <ul> with real entries.

tests.name: judge: action is a button
tests.hint: Buttons perform actions; links navigate. 'Book a table' triggers an action → <button>.
